gen_segmentation_npy: generate a numpy schematic file from raw 3D segmentation component data and save to disk
visualize_segmentation: visualize segmentation data from a pickle file by generating an NPY schematic and rendering it
visualize_segmentation_by_step: visualize segmentation step by step by ordering components by build time and rendering each step
save_order_data: compute and save the build order of segmentation components based on placement timestamps to a pickle file
run_visual_segmentation_cli: run the visual segmentation CLI with modes auto, all, stepbystep, or saveorder to process house component files
